entries.name: GPT Image 2
entries.our_verdict: best prompt adherence and text-in-image; expensive
entries.verdict_keep: beats every open model on prompt adherence and text-in-image at 1380 elo; costs $211/1k images and never runs local

entries.name: MAI-Image-2.6-Preview
entries.our_verdict: new and strong; API access is still coming
entries.verdict_keep: 1324 photorealistic, 56 behind gpt image 2; api access still unconfirmed, so nothing to wire yet

entries.name: Ideogram 4.0
entries.our_verdict: the open-weight image pick; local VRAM is still unverified
entries.verdict_keep: the open-weight image pick at 1219, 21 ahead of flux.2 dev turbo; local vram unverified
entries.license_note: ideogram open model terms unverified — check commercial use before shipping

entries.name: PuLID-FLUX
entries.our_verdict: tight face lock for Flux without training
entries.verdict_keep: tightest face lock on flux pipelines without training; beats instantid on flux but is flux-only

entries.name: InstantID
entries.our_verdict: high identity fidelity on SDXL; can over-anchor prompts
entries.verdict_keep: highest identity fidelity on sdxl; loses to pulid on flux and over-anchors prompts

entries.name: Character LoRA
entries.our_verdict: highest ceiling when you can train on 50+ images
entries.verdict_keep: highest ceiling when you can train on 50+ images; costs 4-8h on a 4090 vs one reference image for adapters
entries.license_note: license varies by training set — check base model and dataset rights

entries.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
entries.our_verdict: current AR quality leader; contested against Wan 3.0 on AA
entries.verdict_keep: leads arena t2v at 1515; loses the aa audio board to wan 3.0 (1237 vs 1242) and never leaves the cloud

entries.name: Wan 3.0
entries.our_verdict: audio board leader; open-weights status unconfirmed
entries.verdict_keep: tops the aa audio board at 1242; absent from arena's top ranks so far and open-weights status unconfirmed

entries.name: MiniMax H3
entries.our_verdict: best local/open video option; territorial license warning
entries.verdict_keep: best open-weights t2v on both boards (1227 aa); 12gb floor with heavy offload, 24gb comfortable
entries.license_note: community license excludes eu, uk, kr, usa — covers output videos too; commercial license only via comfy reseller

entries.name: LTX-2.5 Pro
entries.our_verdict: fast local audio-to-video path; exact VRAM is open
entries.verdict_keep: second open t2v at 1060, 167 behind minimax h3; single-pass audio, local vram unverified

entries.name: MiniMax H3
entries.our_verdict: strongest local same-pass audio workflow; territory restrictions apply
entries.verdict_keep: #1 i2v overall at 1494 and the only local native stereo audio path; same territorial license as the t2v entry
entries.license_note: community license excludes eu, uk, kr, usa — covers output videos too; commercial license only via comfy reseller

entries.name: Seedance 2.0
entries.our_verdict: best defined-speech path when uploaded audio is the input
entries.verdict_keep: the defined-speech pick — lip-syncs to uploaded audio (3 refs, up to 15s); 121 ahead of kling 3.0, behind minimax h3 overall

entries.name: Kling 3.0
entries.our_verdict: voice binding is useful; overall audio ordering is contested
entries.verdict_keep: voice binding from a 5-30s sample is unique, but #17 at 1356, 121 behind seedance; reviewers rank its audio below veo 3.1

entries.name: Realtime TTS-2
entries.our_verdict: current cloning-board leader for fast voice control
entries.verdict_keep: #1 cloning board at 1123 with instant 5-15s cloning; loses the provider-voice board to sonic 3.6

entries.name: Sonic 3.6
entries.our_verdict: best provider-voice score in this snapshot
entries.verdict_keep: #1 provider voice at 1282 with ~90ms time-to-first-audio; cloning board lost to realtime tts-2 (1119 vs 1123)

entries.name: Breeze TTS 2
entries.our_verdict: the open local pick until license and VRAM are checked
entries.verdict_keep: top open tts at 1212 provider elo, 6 ahead of gemini 3.1 flash tts; license and vram still unverified
entries.license_note: license text not yet checked — verify before commercial use

entries.name: Kokoro 82M
entries.our_verdict: small and practical; do not use the stale tts.ai #1 ordering
entries.verdict_keep: runs on cpu where the api leaders need cloud; 1056 elo is 156 below breeze tts 2 — the zero-cost draft voice
